text:
rachel: Kicking off v2 staged rollout in prod-us-west in ~3m. Plan: 5% -> 20% -> 50%. Watch p95, 4xx parse errors, and SDK break reports.

deploybot: Rollout scheduled: id r-us-119, start 6991230020, initial 5%. Pause on parse_errors > 0.5% OR p95 > 2x baseline.

omar: Quick heads-up: v2 changed the top-level response field from `result` to `output` for structured responses to support multi-output. Staging looked fine, but older SDKs assume `result`.

kevin: Which tenants use older SDKs heavily? I can preemptively pin those if we see parse errors.

omar: tenant-oldsdk, tenant-legacy-api, partner-zetta are the big ones.

qa: Canary started at 6991230020. Initial metrics: p95 stable. However we're seeing small number of client parse errors from tenant-oldsdk already (0.3%). Monitoring.

deploybot: Canary progressed to 20% at 6991230035.

qa: Parse errors for tenant-oldsdk jumped to 1.1% at ~6991230042. Stacktrace shows SDK JSON parse failure looking for `result` key.

rachel: Pause rollout. deploybot, pin tenant-oldsdk and tenant-legacy-api to v1. Also enable response-compat shim on canary edge to map `output`->`result` for flagged tenants.

deploybot: Executing:
/deploy pause r-us-119
/deploy pin tenant-oldsdk v1
/deploy pin tenant-legacy-api v1
/edge enable-response-compat tenant-oldsdk,true
/edge enable-response-compat tenant-legacy-api,true
Pins and shims applied; canary paused at 6991230050.

omar: Root cause: API change was intentional, but we missed a backward-compat toggle in the response marshaller. PR #1512 adds a per-tenant compatibility flag and a global opt-in header.

kevin: Good catch. Can we ship the shim as a short-term fix and then schedule a deprecation timeline in release notes so customers can migrate?

rachel: Yes. Plan: 1) keep affected tenants pinned to v1 for now; 2) hotpatch canary edges with the compatibility flag; 3) validate 10m; 4) resume staged rollout with extra 10% hold and operator note to watch parse errors.

release-notes-bot: Draft created: "v2 response schema change (`result` -> `output`) caused parsing errors for older SDKs. We enabled a canary compatibility shim and pinned affected tenants to v1 during mitigation. Customers on older SDKs should upgrade; see migration guide."

qa: After shim and pinback, parse errors for tenant-oldsdk dropped to baseline. No further spread.

rachel: Follow-ups: add compatibility toggle to operator playbook, backport shim to stable branch, and schedule a customer migration email for impacted tenants. Closing this thread; re-open if additional tenants surface.
